title: Union Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - 1,865 Posts, Graduates Apply Before May 19
author: Ash K.
excerpt: Union Bank of India has announced 1,865 Apprentice vacancies under the Apprentice Act 1961. Any graduate can apply. Online applications close May 19, 2026. Monthly stipend Rs 15,000 with banking experience.

related_pages.title: Bank PO vs SSC CGL comparison

body: Union Bank of India has released a recruitment notification for 1,865 Apprentice posts across all states and union territories. This is one of the largest bank apprenticeship drives of 2026 and a great opportunity for fresh graduates looking to enter the banking sector.

Eligibility is straightforward - any graduate from a recognized university in any discipline can apply. Age limit is 20-28 years as on the date specified in the notification. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training under the Apprentice Act in any organization are not eligible.

Apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of approximately Rs 15,000 during the training period of 1 year. The training covers core banking operations - account opening, cash transactions, cheque processing, loan documentation, and digital banking services. This hands-on experience is invaluable for future bank recruitment exams like IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, and SBI PO.

Selection is based on a merit list prepared using graduation percentage marks. There is no written exam - your degree marks are the selection criteria. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD candidates get age relaxation as per government norms. Apply online at unionbankofindia.co.in before May 19, 2026.

callout.heading: Why bank apprenticeship is a smart career move
callout.content: Bank apprenticeship gives you 1 year of real banking experience - the exact skills tested in IBPS PO and Clerk exams. Apprentices who subsequently clear IBPS exams perform significantly better in interviews because they can speak from actual banking experience. Many banks also give preference to former apprentices during recruitment. Think of the Rs 15,000/month stipend as getting paid to prepare for your banking career.

faqs.question: What is Union Bank Apprentice stipend?
faqs.answer: Approximately Rs 15,000 per month during the 1-year apprenticeship period. The exact amount is as per the Apprentice Act 1961 norms and may vary slightly. No other allowances like HRA or DA are provided during apprenticeship. After completing apprenticeship, you receive a National Apprenticeship Certificate.

faqs.question: Is there a written exam for Union Bank Apprentice?
faqs.answer: No - there is no written exam. Selection is purely merit-based on graduation marks. Candidates are shortlisted based on academic percentage in their Bachelor's degree. A state-wise and category-wise merit list is prepared. Higher marks in graduation = better chances of selection.

faqs.question: Will Union Bank Apprenticeship lead to a permanent job?
faqs.answer: Apprenticeship does NOT guarantee permanent employment at Union Bank. It's a training program under the Apprentice Act. However, the banking experience, skills, and National Apprenticeship Certificate you receive make you a stronger candidate for IBPS PO/Clerk and SBI exams. Many successful bank officers started as apprentices.

faqs.question: Can I apply for Union Bank Apprentice from any state?
faqs.answer: Yes - applications are open for all states and union territories. However, you'll be posted as an apprentice in the state you select during application. Choose your home state for convenience. Vacancies are distributed state-wise - some states have more positions than others based on Union Bank's branch network.
